title: FreeCOS: Self-Supervised Learning from Fractals and Unlabeled Images for Curvilinear Object Segmentation
mechanism: Fractal L-system curvilinear structures blended into unlabelled images via Fourier domain adaptation, with intensity-order (geometric) alignment between synthetic and real images.
adaptation: Procedural crack skeletons (L-system or Bezier, branching typical of cell cracks) drawn as dark lines with a measured profile (about 4 px FWHM, per-source contrast from train crack statistics, including the 7% at < 2% contrast) and finger interruptions; FDA-blend onto pool half-cut cells; labels at each source's width. No generator training.
min_experiment: Arm: PF + procedural cracks on half-cut pool cells, 5 seeds. Baseline: PF 5 seeds. Metric: E1 crack relF1@2. Kill: gain < +0.02. Run first; it prices the row-1 renderer.
evidence: R: outperforms unsupervised and self-supervised methods on XCAD, DRIVE, STARE, CrackTree without labels (abstract; numbers not read).
prior_overlap: Partly overlaps CP100 (real crack pixels pasted on pool cells, n.d. on test). Differs in new procedural shapes, physically modelled intensity, FDA appearance matching and half-cut target backgrounds scored on E1.

alt_notes.adaptation: Render L-system cracks as dark Gaussian dips (FWHM 3-5 px, 2-20% contrast, per-source) into crack-free pool cells with a 1.75 px centreline label; use as a pretraining stage for the crack branch, then house fine-tune.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm FreeCOS-style crack pretraining + house fine-tune vs house, 5 seeds; metric test relR@2 at matched relP@2 and E1 relF1@2; kill if relR@2 gain < +0.02.

alt_notes.adaptation: Composite procedural thin dark curves into pool half-cells (including scuff cells) as a pretext stage, then PF fine-tune. Differs from the closed crack copy-paste (real crack patches) by procedural shapes and order-based alignment. Overlaps D06.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: FreeCOS-style pretrain on half-cell pool then PF fine-tune, 5 seeds. Baseline: PF. Metrics: E1 relF1@2, E1 crack false-positive px per half-cut cell. Kill: < +0.03 relF1@2.

alt_notes.adaptation: Pretext stage on pool half-cells (scuff-bearing) so the model sees thin dark curves on half-cut backgrounds, then PF fine-tune on 478 cells.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: FreeCOS pretext then PF fine-tune, 5 seeds. Baseline: PF. Metrics: E1 relF1@2 and crack false-positive px per half-cut cell. Kill: < +0.03 relF1@2.

alt_notes.adaptation: Render fractal dark lines with a 4 px Gaussian profile on CSIR half-cut pool cells; use as a pretext / 10% minibatch share for crack, aimed at E1.
